landing.p2p_sub: Send money to anywhere in the world
landing.feat1_body: Generate cryptographically signed payment links in seconds. Each link is HMAC-SHA256 authenticated and expires automatically.
landing.feat2_body: Real-time Wise interbank FX rates applied at the exact moment of settlement. CLABE · IBAN · ACH · PIX · UPI via Bridge.xyz.
landing.feat3_body: Zero-Data-Retention architecture. All account credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted client-side and never stored on our servers.
landing.pricing_sub: No monthly subscription. No setup fees. Pay only per transaction.
landing.pricing_standard_li2: ✓ Bank transfer rails (SEPA · ACH · PIX · CLABE)
landing.pricing_instant_li2: ✓ Debit card rails (Visa Direct · MC Send)
landing.form_sub: Fill in the details below to create a secure, encrypted payment link.
landing.about_body: OmniPay is payment infrastructure — not a bank. We connect senders and recipients through licensed financial partners. We never hold, store, or have custody of your funds.
landing.disclaimer: OmniPay is a payment technology intermediary. All transactions are processed by licensed partners (Bridge Financial Inc., Stripe, Wise). OmniPay never holds custody of funds.
landing.footer_disclaimer: OmniPay does not hold funds · Partners: Bridge, Stripe, Wise · AES-256 encrypted

p2p.feat3_body: Zero data architecture. Your bank details travel AES-256-GCM encrypted and are never stored on our servers.
p2p.pricing_sub: No hidden fees. No subscription. Pay only when you collect.
